name: 20-hyphens-quotes
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } p { margin: 6px 0; line-height: 1.6; } .hy { hyphens: auto; } .q { quotes: "「" "」" "『" "』"; } .br { word-break: break-all; } .ow { overflow-wrap: break-word; }
html:
hyphenation demonstration with extraordinarily long words such as internationalization and counterrevolutionaries inside a narrow column
